description: Positive vectors for every SPEC-v2 §4 object type. For each signature: signable_b64 is the exact canonical signable projection, message_b64 is the 77-byte M, mldsa_context is the FIPS 204 context, mldsa_tr/mu are the external-mu inputs, and signature holds both deterministic components. wire_b64 is the complete canonical object. An implementation MUST decode wire_b64, re-encode it to identical bytes, derive the same signable bytes, verify every signature with the named verify context, and reproduce every digest.

objects.name: delegation_root_to_intermediate
objects.description: Root delegates to an intermediate, including identity:delegate. Signed by the declared issuer key under code 0x0001.

objects.name: delegation_with_every_v2_constraint_shape
objects.description: Pins canonical encodings of every v2 registry schema: max_rate, ratify.receiver_audience (exact and trust-domain members), resource_path, time_window (wrapping midnight), and max_amount (integer max_amount_micros). Also pins an unregistered type (geo_circle, not in the v2 registry) carrying only type and integer params: it decodes, and evaluation fails closed as constraint_unknown.

objects.name: proof_bundle_two_link_bound_context
objects.description: Leaf-to-root chain with a bound session_context and null stream fields. The presentation signable excludes delegations and challenge_sig; delegation_digest binds the exact signed chain.

objects.name: proof_bundle_empty_chain_stream_bound
objects.description: Empty delegations array (verified with the bundle agent key), null session_context, and a bound stream at sequence 1.

objects.name: revocation_list
objects.description: Full snapshot signed under code 0x0003 by the status key bound to the issuer by caller configuration.

objects.name: revocation_push
objects.description: Push signed under code 0x0005 by the bound status key.

objects.name: key_rotation_genesis
objects.description: Genesis rotation. The current old key signs code 0x0004 and the new key signs the identical body under code 0x0009 (proof of possession).

objects.name: witness_entry_genesis
objects.description: Genesis witness entry; prev_hash is 48 zero bytes and witness_id is the v2 key ID of the caller-authenticated witness key.

objects.name: transaction_receipt_two_parties
objects.description: Two parties sign the identical signable object (parties without proof_bundle, no party_signatures) under code 0x0007. Each bundle's session_context binds the transaction context and that party's required_scope.

objects.name: verification_receipt_allow_genesis
objects.description: Genesis allow receipt signed under code 0x0008 by the caller-authenticated verifier key. receipt_outbox_body_b64 is the sealed pre-append body (no log_id, sequence, previous_receipt_hash, or signature).

objects.name: verification_receipt_constraint_evaluators
objects.description: Genesis allow receipt whose signed body carries constraint_evaluators naming com.ratifyprotocol.max_count with the com.ratifyprotocol.max_count/v1 profile digest; the member is part of the signable projection and of the receipt outbox body.
